extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 was verified as fd9c2383610a7578a3aeb04392aa5d60709346a0cbbcb5292d0d6afde927dcf6; the supplied identity is LCSC C18199101, MPN S2MB, manufacturer hongjiacheng.

The datasheet identity is S2AB THRU S2MB SURFACE MOUNT GENERAL PURPOSE RECTIFIER, Rev:1.1, three pages; the exact S2MB column and grouped curves were examined. The visible manufacturer is Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.

Fig. 3 is a grouped typical forward-voltage curve for S2AB-S2MB at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. The nine points are direct observations from the supplied vector plot at visible voltage positions from 0.5 V through 1.3 V; no intermediate points were synthesized or interpolated.

Fig. 4 is a grouped typical reverse-characteristics plot for S2AB-S2MB at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. The eight points on each curve are direct observations at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%, 120%, and 125% of rated peak reverse voltage; reverse current is represented as the positive magnitude shown on the microampere logarithmic axis, converted to amperes in the curve data, with no intermediate points synthesized or interpolated.

The S2MB electrical-characteristics rows give maximum VF = 1.0 V at IF = 2.0 A, maximum IR1 = 2 microA at VR = VDC = 1000 V and Ta = 25 degC, separate maximum IR2 = 200 microA at VR = VDC = 1000 V and Ta = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 30 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. SI conversions are used in specs: 2 microA = 2e-6 A and 30 pF = 3e-11 F.

Absolute maximum ratings for S2MB include VRRM = 1000 V, VRMS = 700 V, VDC = 1000 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A at 60 Hz sinewave with resistance load, IFSM = 50.0 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, and Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC. These ratings are limits and are not treated as breakdown data.

The supplied datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings, and the Fig. 4 curve knee above rated voltage, are not substituted for breakdown data.
